text:
Maya: Quick preflight pulse — target cut for SDK v1.5 (SDK, docs, quickstarts, sampleapps, changelog) is Wed 18:00 PT. Need owners/quick confirmations for docs review, quickstarts smoke, sampleapp CI, and the changelog slice. Call out blockers if any.
Jon: I can own quickstarts smoke. ETA EOD Tue. Which PRs should I run locally?
Maya: Thanks — quickstarts PRs to validate: https://github.com/redwoodinc/quickstarts/pull/412 and https://github.com/redwoodinc/quickstarts/pull/415. Focus node/python templates. Smoke command: `./scripts/smoke.sh`
Priya: Docs review (guides + migration) — I'll take it, doing a pass tomorrow morning. Any breaking changes we need to highlight in changelog? @Kai?
Kai: Only noteworthy bit is the batching flag flip — `runtime.optimizedBatching` briefly defaulted to false in rc1, we reverted to true in rc2. Add a changelog note "reverted batching flag default" and call out sampleapp env var rename.
Jon: Sampleapp CI is flaky on ember sample: build step failing on node 16.7.3. I can reproduce locally. @DevExBot can you re-run ember-sample CI?
DevExBot: Re-run triggered for ember-sample (build #214). Status: queued.
Maya: Changelog slice template to use for entries: 
```markdown
- SDK: Added new timeout param `request_idle_timeout` (patch)
- Docs: Clarified batching behavior; see issue RBX-567
- Samples: Updated env var names for runtime & migration
```
Assigning changelog edit to Priya once docs pass.
Priya: Ack — I will add entries to CHANGELOG.md PR and ping @release-czar when ready.
Kai: Migration note for Dedicated users: run `rmake migrate-batches --dry-run` before rolling out. Snippet: 
```
# run on infra host
rmake migrate-batches --cluster=dedicated-prod --dry-run
```
Jon: CI retest passed, ember sample build succeeded. I pushed a fix (commit 12a8d9f). I'll open a PR to update CI matrix to include node 16.7.3.
Maya: Current owners: docs=Priya, quickstarts=Jon, samples=Kai, changelog=Priya. Blockers: ember flake (fixed), sample env var mismatch (Kai to update). Target cut Wed 18:00 PT — if no objections we'll tag rc2 at 18:00 and proceed to ship.
Priya: No objections.
Kai: On it — will add migration note to sample README and update sample env docs.
Jon: I'll run a final smoke at 17:00 PT. Ping me if new commits land after that.
Maya: Thanks all. If anything urgent please DM. Tagging folks: @Priya @Jon @Kai :rocket: 
DevExBot: reminder scheduled — release-tagging window opens Wed 17:50 PT.
thread_summary: Preflight coordination for SDK v1.5: owners assigned (docs=Priya, quickstarts=Jon, samples=Kai), ember CI flake fixed, changelog template provided, migration note for Dedicated, target cut Wed 18:00 PT.
